intro: A reagent pouch carried by Burning Blade cultists lurking in the crags of Durotar. Shaman seeking to communing with fire require these gathered spell components to distill their initial fire sapta.

p: To forge a fire sapta and attune a young shaman to the spirits of flame, specific ritual catalysts are vital. Cultists of the Burning Blade carry small satchels stocked with reagents tailored for demonic fire conjurations. The hermit Telf Joolam uses these gathered powders and oils, combined with the fire tar of Razormane quilboar, to craft the draught needed to grant sight into the realm of fire.

Though the Burning Blade perverts flame for destruction and fel sorcery, the physical elements within their pouches remain bound to the primal nature of heat and combustion. Shamanic philosophy maintains that all elemental forces exist in tension: fire is both creator and destroyer. By taking the cultists' stolen tools, a shaman reclaims the elemental medium to awaken genuine communion with the spirits.
